crossRefs.note: Now, Yahweh God, the word that you have spoken concerning your servant, and concerning his house, confirm it forever…
Yahweh, truly I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your servant girl. You have freed me from my chains.
Yet, looking to the promise of God, he didn’t waver through unbelief, but grew strong through faith, giving glory to…
and being fully assured that what he had promised, he was also able to perform.
Fulfill your promise to your servant, that you may be feared.

people.name: Mary
people.line: Mother of Jesus; wife of Joseph.

translations.web: Mary said, “Behold, the servant of the Lord; let it be done to me according to your word.” The angel departed from her.
translations.bsb: “I am the Lord’s servant,” Mary answered. “May it happen to me according to your word.” Then the angel left her.
translations.kjv: And Mary said, Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word. And the angel departed from her.
translations.asv: And Mary said, Behold, the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word. And the angel departed from her.
